description: Service discovery failure scenarios for Protocol Service resilience testing

scenarios.name: Service Not Found
scenarios.description: Simulates a scenario where a required service cannot be found in service discovery

scenarios.name: Network Partition
scenarios.description: Simulates a network partition between Protocol Service and other services

parameters.errorMessage: Service unavailable due to network partition

scenarios.name: Service Timeout
scenarios.description: Simulates slow responses from services that eventually time out

scenarios.name: Intermittent Service Failure
scenarios.description: Simulates services that fail intermittently with a specified failure rate

scenarios.name: Degraded Service Performance
scenarios.description: Simulates services that are responding but with degraded performance

scenarios.name: Cascading Service Failure
scenarios.description: Simulates a cascading failure scenario where multiple dependent services fail in sequence

parameters.errorMessage: Service unavailable due to dependency failure

scenarios.name: Partial Instance Failure
scenarios.description: Simulates a scenario where some instances of a service are failing while others remain operational

parameters.errorMessage: Internal server error in some instances

scenarios.name: Service Registry Failure
scenarios.description: Simulates a failure of the service registry itself

scenarios.name: Invalid Service Data
scenarios.description: Simulates corrupted or invalid service data returned from service discovery

scenarios.name: Service Deregistration
scenarios.description: Simulates services being deregistered from service discovery

circuitBreakerTests.name: Circuit Breaker Trip Test
circuitBreakerTests.description: Tests that circuit breakers trip after specified failure thresholds

circuitBreakerTests.name: Circuit Breaker Recovery Test
circuitBreakerTests.description: Tests that circuit breakers recover after services become healthy again

retryPolicyTests.name: Exponential Backoff Test
retryPolicyTests.description: Tests retry policy with exponential backoff for transient failures

retryPolicyTests.name: Retry with Timeout Test
retryPolicyTests.description: Tests retry policy with overall timeout constraint

bulkheadTests.name: Thread Pool Isolation Test
bulkheadTests.description: Tests thread pool isolation for service calls

bulkheadTests.name: Semaphore Isolation Test
bulkheadTests.description: Tests semaphore-based isolation for service calls

fallbackTests.name: Static Fallback Test
fallbackTests.description: Tests static fallback responses when services are unavailable

fallbackTests.name: Cache Fallback Test
fallbackTests.description: Tests cached fallback responses when services are unavailable
